#+TITLE: Macros, Inline Src, Snippets, Citations

Inline code src_js{const x = 1} appears mid-sentence.

A citation [cite:@doe2020] backs the claim.

An HTML export snippet @@html:<mark>kept</mark>@@ passes through.

A LaTeX export snippet @@latex:\dropped@@ is discarded.

An undefined macro {{{unknown(x)}}} expands to nothing here.
